name: Lease Renewal Desk
office_task: Remind residential tenants their fixed term is ending, chase their answer to the renewal offer the property manager approved, file it, and hand a no or silence to the manager.
systems_of_record: the property management system (PropertyMe, Console Cloud, Property Tree or similar) that issues the tenancy_id and holds the lease end date, the renewal offer the property manager released, and one open item per tenancy for the tenant's answer
the agency's rentals mailbox (Outlook or Gmail) the signed renewal or notice to vacate comes back to, which issues the message_id

emits.write: the tenant's signed renewal or written notice to vacate, filed as evidence against the open item on the tenancy by its tenancy_id, which marks the item arrived and stops every reminder; an email that carries no tenancy_id or item id is never matched on a tenant name, address or phone number
emits.readback: reading the item back by its id returns status arrived with the evidence reference, which names the message_id of the email that carried the signed renewal or notice and the tenancy_id; no evidence reference back means nothing was filed, and the item gets no touch until a person looks

emits.write: an escalation on the tenancy naming the property manager on the cadence: the tenant said no, disputed the offer or asked us to stop, or the item reached its cap with nothing back, carrying every touch so far
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the item id, the tenancy_id, the reason, the touch history and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
